kicker.zh: 型号 / 接口 / 材料

intro.en: Find a cable model or material part number, then send it for a custom replacement or original-part sourcing review.
intro.zh: 按成品型号或材料料号查找，提交编号即可沟通兼容替代件制作或原厂件采购。

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.en: Sensor, actuator, control and industrial network cable assemblies.
intro.zh: 涵盖传感器、执行器、控制与工业网络等电缆组件。

intro.en: Connectors, wire, cable and harness protection materials.
intro.zh: 涵盖连接器、线材、电缆及线束防护材料。

checks_title.en: Six Decisions Behind the Part Number
checks_title.zh: 型号背后的六个选型要点

copy.en: Confirm the connector family, coding, contact sex and straight or angled exit. Check the mating half and installation orientation together.
copy.zh: 确认连接器系列、编码、触点公母和直头或弯头出线，并结合对插件与安装方向一起核对。

copy.en: Define every power, signal and ground position, including conductor size, working voltage and current. Keep power and sensitive signals separated where the circuit requires it.
copy.zh: 逐针定义供电、信号与接地位置，并确认线径、工作电压和电流。按电路要求处理动力与敏感信号的分区。

copy.en: Specify pairs, foil or braid, drain wires and the shield connection at the connector or enclosure. Follow the equipment grounding design rather than a universal termination rule.
copy.zh: 明确线对、铝箔或编织屏蔽、排流线，以及连接器或机壳处的屏蔽连接。端接方式服从设备接地设计。

copy.en: Set length datums, branch positions, exit directions and service loops. Check cabinet depth, connector clearance and the order in which the harness will be fitted.
copy.zh: 确定长度基准、分支位置、出线方向和检修余量，并核对柜体深度、接头空间及线束安装顺序。

copy.en: Identify fixed routing, drag-chain travel or torsion duty, then define bend radius and clamp points. Review jacket and protection against the actual temperature, oil and abrasion exposure.
copy.zh: 区分固定布线、拖链往复或扭转工况，再确定弯曲半径和固定点。结合实际温度、油污与磨损选择护套和防护结构。

copy.en: Keep the drawing, BOM, wire labels and pin map aligned. Define electrical, mechanical and environmental acceptance checks for the actual configured harness.
copy.zh: 保持图纸、BOM、线号和针脚定义一致，并针对实际配置确定电气、机械与环境验收项目。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。
